verdict: M1516 correctly binds the M1458/M1510/M1512/M1513 identities and its builder, plane copier, O_EXCL attempt, no-replace publication, population gate, disabled CLI and future M1517 gate behave as specified. However, the result seal verifier authenticates only a self-consistent set of bytes and paths. An independently forged pre-seal manifest with wrong D0 scale/encoding, duplicate global order, fold/normalize/coerce enabled and cycles=true was accepted; a noncanonical positive-plane path was also accepted. Therefore this review does not authorize M1518. M1516 remains immutable and a successor must make the seal verifier compare against an independently regenerated exact canonical manifest.

p0.reproduction_1: seal_staging accepted a 122-member directory whose manifest changed D0 scale to ONE, D0 encoding to exact_binary, fold/normalize/coerce to true, duplicated capture_global_order and set cycles=true
p0.reproduction_2: seal_staging accepted a renamed noncanonical positive-plane file when the forged manifest and sealed member agreed
p0.impact: A later result hammer using verify_materialized_seal alone could cite a byte-sealed result that violates the M1510 numeric contract and M1516 no-fold/no-performance boundary.
p0.required_fix: A new immutable successor must regenerate the expected manifest from exact M1510/M1458 authority and require exact semantic equality plus canonical path/SHA bindings during seal and post-publication verification.
